40022840.author: पदार्थः
40022840.content: तत् that, सर्वम् all, अखिलेन completely, आशु quickly, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forth, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, हयं horse, लक्षणसम्पन्नं endowed with auspicious marks, कृष्णसारं black-spotted, मुमोच released, ह indeed.

40022840.author: Translation
40022840.content: Having quickly sent forth all those arrangements completely, Rama, Bharata's elder brother, then released the black-spotted horse, which was endowed with auspicious marks, for the sacrifice.

40022841.author: पदार्थः
40022841.content: ऋत्विग्भिः with the priests, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, सार्धम् together with, अश्वतन्त्रे in the protection of the horse, नियोज्य having appointed, च and, ततः then, अभ्यगच्छत् proceeded towards, काकुत्स्थः Rama, सह with, सैन्येन the army, नैमिशम् Naimisha.

40022841.author: Translation
40022841.content: After appointing Lakshmana along with the priests to supervise the sacrificial horse, Rama then proceeded towards Naimisha with his army.

40022842.author: पदार्थः
40022842.content: यज्ञवाटं the sacrificial enclosure, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमम् extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रबर्षम् great joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, श्रीमान् the glorious one, इति thus, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022842.author: Translation
40022842.content: Having seen the extremely wonderful sacrificial enclosure, the glorious and mighty-armed Rama felt incomparable joy and spoke these words.

40022843.author: पदार्थः
40022843.content: नैमिषे in Naimisha, वसतस्तस्य while he (Rama) was residing, सर्व एव all indeed, नराधिपाः kings, आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च brought gifts and, तान् them, रामः Rama, प्रत्यपूजयत् honored in return.

40022843.author: Translation
40022843.content: While Rama was residing in Naimisha, all the kings brought him gifts, and Rama, in turn, honored them.

40022844.author: पदार्थः
40022844.content: उपकार्या suitable dwellings, महार्हाश्च and very valuable, पार्थिवानां for the kings, महात्मनाम् great-souled, सानुगानां along with their followers, नरश्रेष्ठो the best among men (Rama), व्यादिदेश assigned, महामतिः the great-minded one.

40022844.author: Translation
40022844.content: The great-minded Rama, the best among men, arranged for valuable and suitable lodgings for the great kings and their retinues.

40022845.author: पदार्थः
40022845.content: अन्नपानानि food and drinks, वस्त्राणि clothes, सानुगानां for those with their followers, महात्मनाम् great-souled, भरतः Bharata, सन्ददावाशु quickly distributed, शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा then along with Shatrughna.

40022845.author: Translation
40022845.content: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna, then swiftly provided food, drinks, and clothes for the great-souled kings and their followers.

40022846.author: पदार्थः
40022846.content: वानराश्च and the Vanaras, महात्मानः great-souled, सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा then along with Sugriva, विप्राणां for the Brahmins, प्रणताः bowing down, सर्वे all, चक्रिरे performed, परिवेषणम् serving (food).

40022846.author: Translation
40022846.content: Then, all the great-souled Vanaras, led by Sugriva, humbly served food to the Brahmins.

40022847.author: पदार्थः
40022847.content: बिभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः by many Rakshasas, स्रग्विभिर्वृतः surrounded by garland-wearing ones, ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां of the sages of severe penance, पूजां worship, चक्रे performed, महात्मनाम् great-souled.

40022847.author: Translation
40022847.content: Vibhishana, accompanied by many garland-wearing Rakshasas, performed worship for the great-souled sages of severe penance.

40022848.author: पदार्थः
40022848.content: एवं thus, सुविहितो well-arranged, यज्ञो sacrifice, हयमेधो Ashvamedha, अभ्यवर्तत proceeded, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अगुप्ता unguarded, च and, हयचर्या the horse's wandering, प्रवर्तत proceeded, ईदृशं such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञप्रवरम् the best of sacrifices, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022848.author: Translation
40022848.content: Thus, the well-arranged Ashvamedha sacrifice proceeded, and the horse's journey, unguarded by Lakshmana, also took place, such was this excellent and supreme sacrifice of the lion among kings.

40022849.author: पदार्थः
40022849.content: न not, अन्यः other, शब्दो sound, अभवत् was, तत्र there, हयमेधे in the Ashvamedha, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, छन्दतो according to desire, देहि give, विस्रब्धो confidently, यावत् until, तुष्यन्ति are satisfied, याचकाः supplicants.

40022849.author: Translation
40022849.content: In the great-souled Rama's Ashvamedha, no other sound was heard except "Give freely and confidently until the supplicants are satisfied."

40022850.author: पदार्थः
40022850.content: तावत् then, सर्वाणि all, दत्तानि were given, क्रतुमध्ये in the midst of the sacrifice, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, विविधानि various, च and, गौडानि jaggery sweets, खाण्डवानि sugar sweets, तथैव similarly, च and.

40022850.author: Translation
40022850.content: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.

40022851.author: पदार्थः
40022851.content: न not, निस्सृतं emerged, ओष्ठात् from the lips, वचनं word, यावत् until, अर्थिनाम् of the supplicants, तावत् then, वानररक्षोभिर् by monkeys and rakshasas, दत्तमेव indeed given, अभ्यदृश्यत was seen.

40022851.author: Translation
40022851.content: Before a word could even emerge from the lips of the supplicants, it was already seen to be given by the monkeys and rakshasas.

40022852.author: पदार्थः
40022852.content: न not, कश्चित् anyone, मलिनस् dirty, तत्र there, दीनो poor, वा or, अपि even, अथ moreover, कृशः emaciated, तस्मिन् in that, यज्ञवरे excellent sacrifice, राज्ञो of the king, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते filled with happy and well-nourished people.

40022852.author: Translation
40022852.content: In that excellent sacrifice of the king, which was filled with happy and well-nourished people, there was no one who was dirty, poor, or emaciated.

40022853.author: पदार्थः
40022853.content: ये those who, च and, तत्र there, महात्मानो great-souled ones, मुनयः sages, चिरजीविनः long-lived, न not, अस्मरन् remembered, तादृशं such, यज्ञं a sacrifice, न not, अपि even, आसीत् was, सः that, कदाचन ever.

40022853.author: Translation
40022853.content: Even the great-souled, long-lived sages present there had never remembered or witnessed such a sacrifice before.

40022854.author: पदार्थः
40022854.content: यः whoever, कृत्यवान् had a need, सुवर्णेन for gold, सुवर्णं gold, लभते obtained, स्म indeed, सः he, वित्तार्थी one desiring wealth, लभते obtained, वित्तं wealth, रत्नार्थी one desiring jewels, रत्नम् jewels, एव indeed, च and.

40022854.author: Translation
40022854.content: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.

40022855.author: पदार्थः
40022855.content: रजतानां of silver, सुवर्णानाम् of gold, अश्मनाम् of jewels, अथ and, वाससाम् of clothes, अनिशं constantly, दीयमानानां being given, राशिः a heap, समुपदृश्यते was seen.

40022855.author: Translation
40022855.content: Heaps of silver, gold, jewels, and clothes, constantly being distributed, were visible everywhere.

40022856.author: पदार्थः
40022856.content: न not, शक्रस्य of Indra, धनेशस्य of Kubera, यमस्य of Yama, वरुणस्य of Varuna, वा or, ईदृशः such, दृष्टपूर्वः seen before, न not, एवम् thus, ऊचुः said, तपोधनाः the ascetics.

40022856.author: Translation
40022856.content: The ascetics declared that such a spectacle had never been seen before, not even in the realms of Indra, Kubera, Yama, or Varuna.

40022857.author: पदार्थः
40022857.content: सर्वत्र everywhere, वानराः monkeys, तस्थुः stood, सर्वत्र everywhere, एव indeed, च and, राक्षसाः rakshasas, वासः clothes, धन wealth, अन्नम् food, अर्थिभ्यः to the supplicants, पूर्णहस्ताः with full hands, ददुः gave, भृशम् abundantly.

40022857.author: Translation
40022857.content: Monkeys and rakshasas were present everywhere, giving clothes, wealth, and food abundantly with full hands to all who sought them.

40022858.author: पदार्थः
40022858.content: ईदृशः such, राजसिंहस्य of the lion among kings, यज्ञः sacrifice, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all good qualities, संवत्सरम् a year, अथो and, साग्रम् more than, वर्तते continues, न not, च and, हीयते diminishes.

40022858.author: Translation
40022858.content: Such a sacrifice of the lion among kings, endowed with all good qualities, continued for more than a year without diminishing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 92 ।। Thus ends the ninety-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
